# Atomic number of oxygen (Compose RAG demo)

The atomic number (Z) of an element is the number of protons in its nucleus. Oxygen has atomic number 8 and 8 protons. A neutral oxygen atom has 8 electrons.

This short paragraph is a paraphrase for an integration demo, not a quotation. Verify the statements in these primary sources:

- OpenStax, Chemistry 2e, section 2.3, Table 2.4: https://openstax.org/books/chemistry-2e/pages/2-3-atomic-structure-and-symbolism
- OpenStax, Chemistry 2e, section 21.1: https://openstax.org/books/chemistry-2e/pages/21-1-nuclear-structure-and-stability
